prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1421; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection, reporting right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Initial evaluation revealed effusion and medial joint line tenderness with a positive McMurray test, and imaging was obtained to rule out fracture. Radiographs showed no acute bony abnormality, and MRI findings were consistent with a partial tear of the medial meniscus with associated mild joint effusion.

Over the course of 25 outpatient visits, the patient completed a structured program of physical therapy focused on quadriceps and hamstring strengthening, range-of-motion restoration, and gait retraining. Pain was managed with activity modification, cold therapy, and short-term nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medication. Progress was gradual, with steady improvement in swelling, flexion, and weight-bearing tolerance.

At discharge from active treatment, the patient demonstrated near-full range of motion, improved strength, and reduced pain with daily activities, though occasional discomfort persists with prolonged kneeling and stair descent. Continued home exercise and activity monitoring are recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of mechanical symptoms.
